reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that governs agent-turn execution by enforcing configurable step, tool-call, and provider-token budgets before subsequent model requests or tool dispatches.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体回合提供可配置的步骤数、工具调用次数和提供商令牌用量限制。
summaries.en: Enforces configurable per-turn limits for model steps, tool calls, and provider-reported token usage in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Limits model steps per agent turn
Denies tool execution after the configured per-turn allowance is reached
Tracks provider-reported token usage per agent turn
Records policy outcomes in the session log
